title: Preservation of a zero column
statement:
Let $
u$ be a finite coordinate set, let $z\\in\\nu$, and let $C$ be a list of coordinates and $R$ a list of linear equations over $\\mathbb{F}_2$. If every equation in $R$ has coefficient zero at $z$, then every pivot equation and every residual equation produced by eliminating along $C$ also has coefficient zero at $z$.
hypotheses_covered: A list of linear equations over $\mathbb{F}_2$
Every input equation has coefficient zero at $z$
